name: cv-layout-measurer
title: Resume Layout Measurer and Typesetter
summary: Measures page geometry, line overflow/slack, and renders PDF/SVG via embedded Typst.
known_limitations: Uses bundled Libertinus Serif font faces; external arbitrary fonts require host fonts.

cv:layout-measurer/measurer@0.1.0#measur.summary: Calculates page count, overflow points, and estimated lines over/under page budget.

cv:layout-measurer/measurer@0.1.0#render.summary: Compiles resume to PDF bytes with layout measurement.
Compiles resume to vector SVG pages.
